name: Ghost Serpent, Lesser
body:
School transmutation; Level: serpent warlock 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

Components: V, S, M (a serpent’s scale and a pinch of grave dirt)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Touch

Target(s): One snake or snake-like creature

Duration: 1 minute/level

Saving Throw: Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance: yes (harmless)

This spell was created to allow snakes to serve as assassins that can easily penetrate a target’s lair. This spell temporarily 132 gives any snake or snake-like creature the incorporeal subtype, allowing it to move through walls and objects. However, the creature may not use any poison or constriction abilities when in ghost serpent form. The creature immediately becomes corporeal when it attacks, ending the spell.
